matched_controls.matched_components: 2 massless graviton helicities, UV-finite topological Casimir stress tensor, maximal sub-injectivity causal diamond (rho_S = L_min/2 on T^3 vs a*sin(chi_inj) on S^3/Gamma)
matched_controls.treatment_result: All 5 ADE isotropy-irreducible spherical space forms have strictly positive (focusing) pure-graviton Casimir null energy (pi^2*Delta_C_top in [+0.8123, +129.0613], tightening area ceiling Delta_s_* in [-15.3488, -2.2123] across all 10 tested dS_4/Gamma configs).
matched_controls.control_result: Flat cubic T^3 has strictly negative (defocusing) pure-graviton Casimir energy u_grav = -1.675074/L^4 < 0 (Xi/(1/s) = -2.7554, Delta_s_* = +1.8369 > 0), while sharing L-independent (a-independent) O(1) scaling of Delta_s_*.
matched_controls.conclusion: The a-independence of Delta_s_* = O(1) is universal 4D conformal dimensional analysis (shared with flat T^3), whereas the strictly positive focusing sign across all 5 ADE manifolds is genuinely spherical-space-form-specific.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical odd-order lens space L(3,1) (|G|=3, N_KV=4, identical Berger-sphere geometry) with 2 massless bosonic helicities (spin-2 EH graviton vs spin-1 Maxwell photon)
matched_controls.treatment_result: Pure spin-2 graviton on L(3,1) exhibits an isolated low-order Hopf-parallel defocusing anomaly (pi^2*u = +0.8216 > 0, pi^2*p_par = -1.6576, pi^2*T_uu^par = -0.8360 < 0, defocusing cone theta < 32.49 deg), triple-verified via Hurwitz+digamma, Abel-Plana (err 2.45e-48), and heat kernel (err 4.18e-08).
matched_controls.control_result: Matched spin-1 Maxwell field on L(3,1) has exact rational pi^2*p_par^EM = 0 (Bernoulli proof; L(2,1) check = 1/16) and stays strictly focusing along the Hopf fiber (pi^2*T_uu^par,EM = +4/9 = +0.4444 > 0).
matched_controls.conclusion: The isolated L(3,1) Hopf-parallel defocusing anomaly is a genuine spin-2 spectral effect driven by a positive topological slope remainder S_slope(p) > 0 (e.g. S_slope(3)=+112, S_slope(4)=+864, reflecting a deficit of high-|M_L| negative-slope modes relative to S^3 combined with odd-order period-6 parity structure), absent for spin-1 Maxwell fields.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical coupled FLRW + Raychaudhuri ODE solvers (DOP853 & Radau, rtol=1e-13, atol=1e-18) on round S^3 (K_top = 0) and macroscopic limit a = 1e12*a_Cas
matched_controls.treatment_result: Non-trivial ADE quotients S^3/Gamma (Gamma != {1}) generate strictly nonzero focusing Xi/(1/s) in [+3.2681, +10.1650] and ceiling tightening Delta_s_* in [-15.3488, -2.2123].
matched_controls.control_result: Round S^3 exact dS_4 recovers Xi === 0 (0.00e+00) and u_*/rho_S === 1 (0.00e+00); flat-space limit a = 1e12*a_Cas recovers Xi = 9.55e-26 and |u_*/rho_S - 1| = 3.18e-26.
matched_controls.conclusion: All reported focusing shifts originate purely from nontrivial quotient topology Gamma != {1}, with exact recovery of Chandrasekaran Eq. (5.21c) in both covering-space and flat-space limits.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical S^3/Gamma TT spectrum across all 5 ADE space forms; compares physical-TT-only static-background (H -> 0 ESU) limit against exact on-shell global dS_4/Gamma Bunch-Davies vacuum (Ford-Parker minisuperspace stress tensor)
matched_controls.treatment_result: Physical-TT static-ESU limit gives pi^2*Delta_C_top(I*) = +129.0613 (Delta_s_*^tip = -2.3365, N_V^crit = 5).
matched_controls.control_result: On-shell global dS_4/I* Ford-Parker BD gives pi^2*Delta_C_top^BD(bounce) = +120.2650 (+110.7927 a^-4 + +9.4723 a_dS^-2 a^-2; Delta_s_*^tip = -2.1824, N_V^crit = 4; prescription-indep a^-4 alone gives N_V^crit = 4), with strictly positive focusing across all 5 ADE space forms (bounce diff 6.23%--8.72%, integrated Delta_s_* diff 2.35%--8.43%).
matched_controls.conclusion: Positive pure-graviton focusing across all 5 ADE space forms is robust between the exact on-shell global dS_4/Gamma Bunch-Davies vacuum and the static-ESU TT limit, shifting bounce amplitudes by 6.23%--8.72% (6.60%--6.82% on S^3/I*) and shifting S^3/I* dark-photon crossover from N_V >= 5 (ESU) to N_V >= 4 (BD).

Spatial Killing vectors at p=2 (6 on S^3, RP^3; 4 on L(p,1), p>=3; 3 on Q_8, D_m*, T*, O*, I*) satisfy h_ij^V===0 and enforce global Isom_0 angular-momentum constraints Q[K_A]=0 (Moncrief 1975/76) with zero local propagating DOF and zero local bulk <T_uv> shift. domain_of_validity.regime: 1-loop semiclassical pure-vacuum-GR graviton (+ free conformal gauge/scalar matter) QFT on globally hyperbolic cosmological quotients (on-shell global dS_4/Gamma and physical-TT static-background H -> 0 limit) in the macroscopic EFT regime a >> a_Cas and L_min(a) >> l_sp^red.
caveats: Vacuum & Stress-Tensor Prescription: The on-shell vacuum background is global dS_4/Gamma (whereas static R_t x S^3/Gamma is only the physical-TT H -> 0 limit, not an on-shell pure-GR vacuum). On global dS_4/Gamma, Delta_T_uu^BD uses the Ford-Parker / exponential-parameterization minisuperspace TT effective stress tensor: the leading a^-4 radiation piece (+110.7927 on S^3/I*, alone giving N_V^crit = 4) is prescription-independent, whereas the subleading O(a_dS^-2 a^-2) curvature piece (+9.4723, 7.9% of bounce total) differs from linear-metric <G_uv^(2)[h]> by O(H^2 <h^2>) prescription terms. Switching between static-ESU TT and Ford-Parker BD preserves strictly positive focusing across all 5 ADE space forms (bounce diff 6.23%--8.72%, 6.60%--6.82% on S^3/I*) while shifting S^3/I* dark-photon flip from N_V >= 5 (ESU) to N_V >= 4 (BD).

Weak-Coupling Deconfined Regime for Non-Abelian SU(2) Switch (CLM-T2-03): The 1-loop Ad(rho_i)-twisted pure-YM Casimir energies on S^3/I* hold strictly in the weakly coupled deconfined UV regime g_YM(1/a) << 1 (L_min << Lambda_YM^-1); in the macroscopic IR regime L_min >> Lambda_YM^-1, confinement exponentially suppresses the YM Casimir shift as O(exp(-m_gap * L_min)).

Static Round Metric for Anisotropic Quotients: Anisotropic Berger-sphere graviton pressures (p_par, p_perp) on L(p,1) and S^3/D_m* are evaluated at the round metric (lam_B = 1) using the exact scale-covariant 3D Lichnerowicz operator -Delta_2 - 2*R_{ikjl} h^{kl}; per CLM-RET-01 / CLM-T3-02, O(100%) Casimir shear drives dynamical Berger-sphere squashing backreaction (a_3 != a_perp) once a approaches a_Cas.

Species-Scale Cutoff (CLM-T3-01): Across all 5 ADE space forms and all N_V >= 0 (including pure gravity N_V = 0 where L_min(a_Cas)/l_sp^red = 0.92758 and static |Xi|=1 proxy L_min/l_sp^red = 0.43594 on S^3/I*; dynamical dS_4 with K_top > 0 has no bounce for a_b < sqrt(2)*a_Cas), the nonperturbative |Xi| ~ O(1) regime sits strictly below the Dvali species scale (L_min < l_sp^red), where 1-loop semiclassical gravity EFT breaks down.

Semiclassical Backreaction vs Local Null-Cone Algebra: Chandrasekaran (arXiv:2611.34924) quantizes pure vacuum GR inside a single causal diamond; the global 1-loop Casimir stress tensor enters semiclassical Raychaudhuri focusing as a c-number vacuum expectation value <T_uu> shifting the macroscopic area ceiling by a finite constant Delta_s_* without modifying the local single-diamond canonical algebra.
